definitions.explanation: Not necessary or required. The negation of {必要|ひつよう} (necessary). Used to describe things that can be omitted or are not essential.

examples.japanese: {不必要|ふひつよう}な⟦{出費|しゅっぴ}→出費：09205_shuppi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避|さ}けたい→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to avoid unnecessary expenses.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不必要|ふひつよう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think that explanation is unnecessary.

examples.japanese: {不必要|ふひつよう}な⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧しないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
Na-adjective formed by adding the negative prefix {不|ふ} to ⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧ (necessary).

FORMS:
- {不必要|ふひつよう}な + noun ({不必要|ふひつよう}な⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ = unnecessary things)
- {不必要|ふひつよう}に + verb ({不必要|ふひつよう}に⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = worry unnecessarily)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不要|ふよう}→不要：02527_fuyou⟧ - unneeded (more common in compounds)
- ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧ - wasteful, useless
- ⟦いらない→いらない：noentry⟧ - don't need (casual)
